title: Long-Term Fairness Inquiries and Pursuits in Machine Learning: A Survey of Notions, Methods, and Challenges

bias_targets.methodology: Surveying dynamic modeling frameworks (e.g., Pólya urns, Markov Decision Processes, Multi-Armed Bandits) and mathematical formulations to track and mitigate group-level fairness disparities (such as effort-based fairness, cumulative utility, and delayed impact) over extended periods.
Reviewing literature on item-side fairness in recommender systems to evaluate how disproportionate exposure dynamically affects item popularity, ranking, and long-term user interaction.
